call.t: Proof of Concept & Technology Validation Call
rs: The eligible countries are not stated in structured form by EIT opportunities (eit.europa.eu, European Institute of Innovation and Technology). Check the call page.
call.x: Proof of Concept & Technology Validation Call Opportunity 06/11/2026 12.00 - CET 18/01/2027 12.00 - CET Food The EIT Food Biotech Proof of Concept Call helps biotech startups bridge two critical gaps in technology development: Route 1 (Validation) for technologies at TRL 4–6 and Route 2 (Demonstrator) for technologies at TRL 7–9. A ‘Proof of Concept’ is a small-scale project that tests whether a technology, product or service can work in practice and meet the needs of a potential customer. For biotech startups, this stage is critical because many promising innovations fail before they reach the market due to two distinct funding and development gaps, often referred to as ‘valleys of death’....

HE-GA-B.title: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027, General Annexes, B - Eligibility

consortium.quote: Unless otherwise provided for in the specific call/topic conditions, only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: – at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and – at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
